description: Defines the MessageAction class for displaying messages to users within Drupal, including configuration, execution, and access control.

classes.name: MessageAction
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that displays a message to the current user, configurable with placeholders and integrated with Drupal's messaging system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MessageAction with token, renderer, and messenger services.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the action by rendering and displaying the configured message to the user.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the message, initially empty.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the form for configuring the message, including placeholder instructions.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles submission of the configuration form, saving the message and unsetting the node.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if the action is allowed for the current user, returning an AccessResult.
